full_judgment: 4. Defendant no.1 by filing a separate written statement contested the suit contending inter alia that the suit land cannot be leased out permanently according to law. The plaintiffs obtained the lease by suppressing facts. The plaintiffs with the help of some other interest and dishonest persons described the suit land as agricultural one. The scrutiny committee appointed by the government found that permanent lease in favour of the plaintiffs is illegal and improper and recommended for cancellation. The cancellation was just and legal. Plaintiffs never paid any rent or salami nor the plaintiffs executed Kabuliyat. The suit land is possessed by the defendants and has been leased out temporarily to different persons for catching and rearing fish.
